analyzed_vuln.description: The vulnerability is a global buffer overflow in the function libraw_tagtype_dataunit_bytes. It occurs because the function accesses an out-of-bounds index in the static array _tagtype_dataunit_bytes when the input tagtype is greater than the size of the array. The overflow happens when an unchecked or invalid tagtype is passed as an argument, leading to reading memory beyond the allocated buffer.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The bug is triggered when the function libraw_tagtype_dataunit_bytes is called with an integer argument (tagtype) greater than or equal to the size of the _tagtype_dataunit_bytes array. This can happen when user input or crafted data is not properly validated before being passed to the function.
